source_summary: Vertical monochrome Chinese landscape with towering ink cliffs, misty water, distant hills and buildings, a scholar pavilion terrace, gnarled pines, bare winter branches, bridges, rocks, and willow/reed forms. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_cliff_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the tall craggy mountain mass on the upper left, including the sheer vertical peak, adjacent left spurs, clustered pine trees on ridgelines and summits, and descending ink-shadowed ravines.
must_preserve: jagged ink contour lines along cliff edges
dry-brush vertical rock texture and dark crevice washes
small pine clusters with pointed needle strokes on the ridge tops
pale unpainted rock faces contrasting with gray mist wash
steep diagonal ravine cuts and broken brush accents

motifs.name: central_rock_spire_with_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the slimmer middle-distance rock spire rising from mist below the main cliffs, with a pine-crowned peak and dark vertical rock cuts.
must_preserve: pine tufts at the crest with fine dark needles
irregular rock outline tapering into mist
dark diagonal fissure across the face
soft gray wash at the base where the form dissolves
short interior texture strokes on pale rock

motifs.name: distant_layered_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant mountain range stretching across the right half behind the lake, including overlapping low peaks and mist-softened slopes.
must_preserve: thin undulating ridge contours
subtle overlapping hill silhouettes
soft gray wash separations between layers
misty lower edge fading into the lake
pale ochre-toned reserved mountain faces

motifs.name: misty_moon_water_band
motifs.description: Isolate the open atmospheric band of lake and sky in the upper-middle right, including the small round moon and horizontal mist washes.
must_preserve: small pale circular moon
broad horizontal gray wash bands
soft blurred mist transitions
empty water-sky space without added objects
very faint tonal variations suggesting distance

motifs.name: distant_lakeside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the small cluster of distant buildings and trees on the far right shore across the water, including tiered roof pavilions, low houses, and conifers softened by mist.
must_preserve: tiny tiered roof geometry with upturned eaves
low hut rooflines between trees
thin vertical conifer silhouettes
mist partially veiling building bases
delicate scale contrast against the open lake

motifs.name: scholar_pavilion_terrace
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground pavilion terrace at lower left with the roofed study, railing, seated scholar figures, table, stools, and the immediate platform architecture.
must_preserve: angular tiled roof and triangular gable details
straight railing posts and terrace floor lines
two seated scholar figures with fine robe outlines
small table and interior furnishing marks
dark ink linework defining beams, screens, and platform edges

motifs.name: central_gnarled_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the large twisted pine rising beside and above the pavilion, with its bent trunk, exposed knots, long branches, and spreading needle clusters.
must_preserve: gnarled trunk contour with knots and hollows
long angular branches crossing diagonally
dense needle clusters made of short dark strokes
hanging fine twig lines beneath branches
dry-brush bark texture and dark root-like bends

motifs.name: lower_right_willow_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the waterside willow and reed clump in the lower right foreground, including drooping leaf strands, arched stems, and the low rocky bank with bare twigs behind it.
must_preserve: long drooping willow or reed leaves drawn in fine lines
arched stalk outlines with pale interiors
small bare branch network at the base
soft water wash surrounding the plants
delicate ink accents along the low bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
